name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Partner Success & Implementation | Channel Programs, Scalable Onboarding & Partner Growth
summary: Partner success and implementation professional with 15+ years in B2B SaaS. Ran a reseller channel of 15-20 partners at Birdeye, including agencies serving healthcare clients, onboarding and enabling them through repeatable training and communication workflows and retaining all but one. Led a team of 20 (later 8) onboarding specialists at Wix, building the processes that took a new business line from proof of concept to profitable. Builds the playbooks, templates, and automation that let high-touch onboarding scale, and advises executives on operational change.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Own the primary relationship for a portfolio of service-business clients, from discovery and onboarding through ongoing performance reviews and retainer expansion.
Lead end-to-end onboarding for new technology stacks, translating business requirements into configurations and integrations (Zapier, Make, n8n) and training client teams.
Build reusable templates, messaging frameworks, and automated onboarding workflows that keep a high-touch experience consistent as clients are added.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Managed multi-stakeholder accounts as strategic lead, coordinating execution across internal departments and presenting performance and recommendations in QBRs.

experience.title: Partner Success (Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding)
bullets: Onboarded and managed a channel of 15-20 reseller partners (deal sizes ~$10K-$45K) across health, home services, and retail, including agencies serving healthcare clients; retained all but one (~94%).
Built scalable communication workflows and automated partner-training sequences that reduced onboarding friction and helped partners represent the product confidently.
Advised partners on retention strategy, customer health metrics, and automated workflows for their own end customers.
Analyzed partner utilization and performance data in Salesforce to spot adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.
Fed structured, prioritized partner feedback to Product and Engineering to inform the roadmap.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Served a banking-industry client and was part of a finalist-stage pursuit of a major banking prospect; led the sales team and improved cross-team handoffs.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Led a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years (20, later 8), overseeing budgets, scope, and delivery, and helped hire and train new team members.
Drove process improvements for a new vertical that went from proof of concept to a profitable business line.
Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month at 110% of implementation targets and 120% of sales targets.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Built sequenced implementation plans for incoming clients and advised C-suite executives on operational system design and API integrations; ranked top three in sales while quota roughly doubled.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
